turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Hello, Daniel Lim. This is Grace Chen for our scheduled telephone appointment. Is this still a convenient time to speak privately?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Hello, Grace. Yes, I'm in my study at home. 今天不用赶回公司，电话谈很方便。

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you. Before we begin, please provide your identification details for the call.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: 我的身份证件号码是T七一六一三四九P。 我的出生日期是一九七三年十月九日。

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you for those details. How was your family trip? I hope you had some time away from the usual business calls.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: 挺好的，家人难得都能抽空。我们没有把行程排得太满，想休息就找地方坐坐。I left the routine work with my team, so I wasn't checking messages throughout the day.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: That sounds like a welcome break. Now that you're back, would telephone appointments generally be easier to arrange than visits to the branch?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: 电话比较好安排，尤其是公司临时有事的时候。不过资料我还是喜欢自己在电脑上看。For anything that needs a longer conversation, I'd rather book a quiet slot than take a call between meetings.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: We can keep using scheduled calls and make documents available through secure banking. If an appointment no longer works, you can contact me to rearrange it rather than trying to fit it into a busy day.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: That would be helpful. 私人银行的文件我自己处理，不想混进公司的日常邮件里。平时办公室电话多，在家里谈反而不容易被打断。

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Understood; we can use the secure banking channel for the documents. Turning to our investment discussion, To confirm, your objective is long-term capital growth through diversified global equity exposure, using money you do not need for near-term expenses. I recommend Summit Global Equity ETF because its broad global equity exposure supports your long-term growth objective without requiring you to select individual companies. Its exchange-traded structure also fits your preference for a straightforward investment.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: I'd like to hear the cautions before giving the details. 今天时间留得够，您按正常流程讲就可以。

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: With Summit Global Equity ETF, diversification does not prevent its value from falling when global equity markets decline. Its traded price can also differ from the value of its underlying holdings. You could lose part or even all of the capital you invest. 这笔交易会按成交金额收取百分之零点二的手续费。 Do you understand that broad diversification cannot prevent a market-driven fall in value, and that the trading price may differ from the value of the underlying holdings?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: 我明白，分散投资不代表市场下跌时它不会跌，而且成交价格也可能偏离持仓的资产净值。

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you. I'll now take down the instruction you wish to give.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: 这次交易的产品我选顶峰环球股票交易所交易基金。 I want to buy, not sell. 这笔交易用美金。 The amount I am committing to this transaction is 250k. 交易数量定为七百个单位。 Please place this as a market order.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Please confirm your final instruction: buy 700 units of Summit Global Equity ETF using a market order, with a transaction amount of 250k in US dollars. Is that your final instruction for me to execute?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I confirm that is my final transaction instruction. Please execute it as stated.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you. Please check the formal transaction documentation through secure banking when it is available. You can contact me if you have an administrative query about accessing it.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: I'll look there rather than search through my work inbox. 这样比较清楚，也不用麻烦办公室同事转交。谢谢您今天配合我的时间。

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: You're welcome, Daniel. Thank you for taking the call, and enjoy the rest of your day.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Thank you, Grace. 再见。
